title: Exactness of transported etale sum extension
statement: For an etale morphism f:U→X and a commutative ring A, define L on modules over the constant commutative ring sheaves by ring transport to the constant RingCat sheaf on U, restriction to constant scalars, the canonical sum extension, constant-scalar realization on X, and ring transport back. This concrete functor is exact. Its degreewise action on unbounded cochain complexes preserves acyclicity.

source.place: Tag 0GKF, lemma-f-shriek-projection; its direct-sum totalization expansion

proof.text: The ring transports are equivalences because their coefficient maps are inverse isomorphisms. The constant-scalar restriction is inverse to the constant-scalar realization. All these functors are therefore exact.

Sum extension is exact, so the concrete composite is exact. In each degree, apply it to the exact short complex underlying an acyclic complex. This proves preservation of acyclicity by the degreewise action.

For inverse image, compose the same exact coefficient equivalences with the published upper-star functor on ModuleCat-valued sheaves, whose finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances are already proved. Applying the composite to each exact short complex preserves acyclicity.
